objective: Single-position net +30 percent after signal, with very high probability and observed time-to-target; no fixed holding deadline

formation.breakout: B close above prior 40 highs, above rising MA80, volume at least 1.2 times prior 40-session mean; complete 81-session comparable history
formation.anchor: A=prior40 maximum high; anchor date, price and volume frozen once
formation.retest: First R at B+1..B+9 with A<=low<=1.02*A, close<close_B, volume<=0.8*volume_B
formation.renewal: First T after R and by B+10 with close>high_R, close>prior-session close, volume>=volume_B
formation.invalidate: Low<A takes priority; known ineligibility or effective action invalidates; unknown evidence aborts separately; known halts consume formation deadline
formation.sequenceAfterSignal: Reset detector idle at T; earliest reanchor next session; external positions do not suppress raw pattern observations

selection: Rank all same-day raw sequences by close_T/A-1 ascending, then symbol; mark Top5 before active-event exclusion, never backfill rank6
execution: Separate existing next-session-open single-attempt entry and net +30 opening-price proxy; T+1 sell lock and full-position execution evidence remain external
strictEvidence: Independent calendar, historical eligibility and explicitly verified comparable price/action regime. Empty factors or unchanged preclose do not certify absence of actions.
futurePriceOnlyDiagnostic: Must be separately named and preregistered, preserve unknowns, and cannot claim to implement verified action eligibility or certify the goal
